def build_report_brief_section(columns: Optional[int]=None,
    primary_announcement: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None, report_type: int=1,
    **kwargs: Any) ->str:
    
    if columns is None:
        columns = get_terminal_size().columns
    
    sections = []
    
    if primary_announcement:
        announcement_content = build_primary_announcement(primary_announcement, columns=columns)
        sections.append(announcement_content)
    
    # Add report heading
    sections.append(REPORT_HEADING)
    
    # Get report brief info
    brief_info = get_report_brief_info(report_type=report_type, **kwargs)
    
    # Format brief info
    formatted_brief = []
    for line_group in brief_info:
        for item in line_group:
            if item.get('style'):
                formatted_brief.append(item['value'])
            else:
                formatted_brief.append(item['value'])
    
    sections.extend(formatted_brief)
    
    return '\n'.join(sections)
